José Córdoba (Norwich City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Harry Darling (Norwich City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Jenson Metcalfe (Millwall) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Millwall 1, Norwich City 0.
